evidence_items.observed_summary: The persisted receipt records 230 repository tests run on Windows: 229 passed and one privilege-dependent generic symlink test was skipped.
Three focused plugin tests require one Stop handler, plugin-private state, and an exact five-second timeout.
The official local skill validator accepted the packaged skill.
The official local plugin validator accepted the repository-root plugin.
The offline conformance fixture committed one local proposal, deduplicated replay, and performed no outbound action.
The v0.8.2 package matches its rebuilt manifest and recorded package digest.
The embedded component-evidence 1.3.0 engine identity verified.

A fresh Codex session invoked audit-venue-submission and the v0.8.1 Stop hook, but the host wrapper exited 1 under its one-second timeout; an equivalent local no-op completed in 251 ms with no outbound action.

claims.statement: On this Windows host, the local v0.8.2 candidate ran 230 repository tests: 229 passed and one privilege-dependent generic symlink test was skipped. It passed the official skill and plugin validators, replayed the offline quality-loop conformance fixture without outbound action, and verified its package and embedded engine. A focused regression requires the single Codex Stop hook to use an exact five-second timeout. The preceding live v0.8.1 activation invoked a compatible producer and the Stop hook but timed out, so successful v0.8.2 installed continuation remains unobserved.
claims.rationale: The local candidate and exact timeout contract are tested, while commit-bound CI, publication, v0.8.2 installed activation, an actionable automatic continuation, and Claude runtime invocation remain separate gates.

limitations.text: The evidence validates local v0.8.2 candidate bytes and records a v0.8.1 live timeout; remote CI, publication, v0.8.2 installed activation, successful actionable continuation, and Claude runtime invocation remain unproved.
